description: This file contains functions and data structures for collecting, initializing, and printing statistical data related to the Qhull computational geometry library. It includes functions for defining various statistics, resetting counters, collecting data from facets and vertices, and outputting statistical summaries.

methods.name: qh_allstatA
methods.description: Defines a group of 20 statistics related to precision and output features.

methods.name: qh_allstatB
methods.description: Defines statistics related to output facets, ridges, vertices, and memory usage.

methods.name: qh_allstatC
methods.description: Defines statistics for hull building process, including points processed, visible facets, and merge operations.

methods.name: qh_allstatD
methods.description: Defines partitioning and horizon statistics during the hull construction.

methods.name: qh_allstatE
methods.description: Defines statistics for inside points, coplanar points, and various distance tests.

methods.name: qh_allstatE2
methods.description: Defines statistics for ridge matching, merge determination, and related geometric tests.

methods.name: qh_allstatF
methods.description: Defines statistics for merging operations, including iterations, distances, and horizon cycles.

methods.name: qh_allstatG
methods.description: Defines statistics for various merge causes such as coplanar, concave, and twisted facets.

methods.name: qh_allstatH
methods.description: Defines statistics for vertex merges, renaming, and memory usage.

methods.name: qh_allstatI
methods.description: Defines Voronoi ridge statistics.

methods.name: qh_allstatistics
methods.description: Resets the printed flags for all statistics.

methods.name: qh_collectstatistics
methods.description: Collects statistical data from facets, vertices, and ridges during hull processing.

methods.name: qh_initstatistics
methods.description: Initializes all statistical counters and data structures.

methods.name: qh_newstats
methods.description: Determines if a statistic is new and should be printed.

methods.name: qh_nostatistic
methods.description: Checks if a statistic has its initial value and is thus not to be printed.

methods.name: qh_printallstatistics
methods.description: Prints all collected statistics with a header string.

methods.name: qh_printstatistics
methods.description: Prints statistics for a specific group identified by an index.

methods.name: qh_printstatlevel
methods.description: Prints detailed information for a specific statistic.

methods.name: qh_printstats
methods.description: Prints statistics for a group of statistics starting at a given index.

methods.name: qh_stddev
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation and mean of statistical data.
